scenarios.name: new-card-all-good
scenarios.description: A new card answered Good every time, reviewed exactly when due.

scenarios.name: new-card-easy
scenarios.description: Easy on a new card skips the learning steps.

scenarios.name: new-card-again-then-good
scenarios.description: Repeated Again keeps a new card in learning.

scenarios.name: hard-path
scenarios.description: Hard answers stretch the learning steps and lower the growth of intervals.

scenarios.name: lapse-and-recover
scenarios.description: A mature card is forgotten, relearned, and graduates again.

scenarios.name: late-reviews
scenarios.description: Reviews that happen long after the due date.

scenarios.name: early-review
scenarios.description: Reviews that happen before the due date.

scenarios.name: retention-95
scenarios.description: A higher target retention gives shorter intervals.

scenarios.name: retention-80
scenarios.description: A lower target retention gives longer intervals.

scenarios.name: custom-steps
scenarios.description: Custom learning and relearning steps including hours and a day.

scenarios.name: mixed-grades
scenarios.description: A realistic mix of all four grades.

scenarios.name: maximum-interval-cap
scenarios.description: Intervals never exceed the configured maximum.
